mapper.select: select id, total_reigns, completed_reigns, content_count, status, message, update_time from tj_sync_state where id = 1
mapper.insert: insert into tj_sync_state (id, total_reigns, completed_reigns, content_count, status, message, update_time) values (1, #{totalReigns}, #{completedReigns}, #{contentCount}, #{status}, #{message}, now())
mapper.update: update tj_sync_state set total_reigns = #{totalReigns}, completed_reigns = #{completedReigns}, content_count = #{contentCount}, status = #{status}, message = #{message}, update_time = now() where id = 1
